A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the crystallization and the preliminary X-ray diffraction analysis of beta-phenylethylamine amine oxidase (PAO) from Arthrobacter globiformis has been successful.
the crystal structures of two different forms of the copper amine oxidases from Arthrobacter globiformis and Arthrobacter globigens have been determined to high resolution.
the crystals of the copper amine oxidases are generally very small and the crystallization conditions are very sensitive to small changes in the crystallization medium.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the crystal structures of these two crystal forms of A. globoformis CuAO will provide a detailed picture of the active site, which will help to explain the substrate specificity of this enzyme.
